## Checklist

- [ ] Each entry uses `- [owner/name](url) - Description ending in a period.`
- [ ] Each description is one neutral sentence saying what the source is and why it's useful
- [ ] Entries are in byte (case-sensitive) order within their section, not appended to the bottom
- [ ] Links point to the current location, not a GitHub redirect
- [ ] Unmaintained or archived sources go in `archived.md` with the reason noted
- [ ] `./script/cibuild` passes locally
- [ ] `Contents` is updated if a section was added or renamed
